description: group.parent_group_id's normative requirement: a group MUST NOT be its own parent. This fixture sets parent_group_id equal to the group's own group_id, which would otherwise form a cycle of length one -- a group nested under itself. A conforming validator MUST REJECT this document. Note for implementers: this specific rule is a cross-field constraint that plain JSON Schema (without a $data reference, which this project's schema does not otherwise use) cannot express structurally, so EvalPort's own raw JSON Schema at spec/schemas/resultset.json accepts this document -- it is the hand-rolled SDK validators (sdk/python/openeval/validate.py, sdk/typescript/src/validate.ts) that enforce it, exactly as they already do for other cross-field rules like the (test_case_id, run_id, attempt) DUPLICATE_ATTEMPT uniqueness check. A conformance implementation MUST perform this same cross-field check itself, not assume JSON-Schema-only validation is sufficient for the full ResultSet spec.
